summary: Part B of LEGION-25 on pull request #1110 (branch legion/LEGION-25, cut fresh from main at e7eb2f8a which carries #961). Seven plan tasks, one commit each in order, plus a formatting commit and a rebuilt claude-envoy-bridge bundle: (1) LegionDaemonApi.ControllerSecret, the external controller record on the state response, daemon-API contract 5 -> 6 with the plugin manifest, operator_token_file (required under kubernetes, refused under tmux, never read by --check-config); (2) ExternalControllerLocator / ControllerLocator admitted only on controllerLocator (type and zod), sameProcess by session id, locatorHandles empty, api/state.ts allowlist projection; (3) Runtime.controllerLaunch (daemon|operator) and controllerReadyLocator, KubernetesRuntime's Envoy-backed probe (alive/gone/unknown, controllerLivenessMs = max(boot timeout, 2 x 120 s)), stop no-op for the record; (4) ensureController under operator: mints nothing, arms no deadline, logs 'controller not registered; run legion controller start' once per worker_boot_timeout_seconds; recordControllerReady; controller-environment.ts shared by spawnController and the CLI; (5) POST /legion/v1/controller/secret behind the operator bearer (constant time), 403 for wrong/missing/unconfigured, 400 for a non-empty body; (6) legion controller start CLI with a strict twelve-key operator-side file, 0600 token-file check, secret fetch, state-dir setup, foreground OMP launch, exit code passthrough; (7) manifests (operator Secret mount, operator_token_file in base legion.yaml, kind overlay secretGenerator + operator.env.example), controller.yaml.example, docs/kubernetes.md 'Operator-launched controller', daemon and pi-envoy AGENTS.md, root AGENTS.md Commands, legion-controller skill subsection. Round 2 (reviewer REQUEST_CHANGES at e82da691, review 5204795546): three correctness threads fixed in two commits — 25404b2e (kind overlay legion.yaml carries operator_token_file; the kind walkthrough copies operator.env; a config test loads both shipped legion.yaml files under --check-config) and cb8fa7a7 (legion controller start runs every local check — token files, resolveRolePromptsDir, readDeploymentInstructions — before fetchControllerSecret, so a local failure never revokes the incumbent controller's secret; two regression tests). Conflict-forced rebase onto main 73a526e3 with the architect's go-ahead: head 40fbcb26, fingerprint changed only through release-managed files (CHANGELOG, package.json version, bridge bundles). Round 3 (reviewer REQUEST_CHANGES at 40fbcb26, review 5204985576, the last case of thread r4011301117): `project` is sanitized in loadControllerStartConfig exactly as the daemon does — a new exported config.ts helper legionProjectToken that resolveDaemonConfig now calls too — and the controller token is computed before the fetch (commit 386f3562, pre-rebase 74871c03); two regression tests. Then the standing-order correction (Sami 2026-09-14 19:41Z, spec v21) made the kind proof required: run on a throwaway instance legion-25b at code head 74871c03 against the Worker Image build of that head, recorded in proof[], the PR comment, and the issue artifact kind-run-part-b.md; torn down. A second conflict-forced rebase onto main fb7bdad2 (architect-authorized) followed; the rebase changed only release-managed files.

trickyParts: #961's spawnController reads controllerLocator.ompSessionFile twice; the plan did not list those sites. Rather than teach ProcessManager the record's shape, the narrowing lives in runtime.ts as resumableTranscript(locator) (a process locator's ompSessionFile, undefined for the external record), so processes.ts still reads no runtime-specific locator field — the runtime.contract.test.ts 'ProcessManager stays runtime-agnostic' guards still pass.

Bun's `typeof fetch` requires `preconnect`, which no test fake provides; KubernetesRuntimeDeps.fetch and ControllerStartDeps.fetch are typed as the one call signature each makes (RoleLookupFetch / SecretFetch).

operator_token_file is required under kubernetes, so every existing kubernetes config-test fixture needed a token: a kubernetesOverrides fixture supplies it as the programmatic cliOverrides.operatorToken (the same seam envoyToken uses), and the --check-config CLI test's in-cluster legion.yaml names an operator_token_file under a missing mount to prove it is validated, never read.

packages/claude-envoy-bridge commits a bundle of @legion/contracts; CI's 'Check the committed bundle is fresh' failed at the first push. Rebuilt with `bun run build` on the pinned Bun 1.3.14 and committed (chore commit). Its own suite passes 41/41 once the pane's DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE is unset — one test reads the real bearer from this pane's environment, unrelated to this change.

The controller test in processes.test.ts that occupies the controller's handle narrows the spawned locator with `first?.runtime !== 'kubernetes' || 'external' in first` because FakeRuntime.connect/occupyHandle take Locator, not ControllerLocator.
deviations: One extra commit beyond the plan's seven: `style(daemon): biome formatting and import order for LEGION-25 Part B` (biome --write over the touched files), and one more for the rebuilt claude-envoy-bridge bundle the contract change made stale.

The plan's Task 2 named `redactLocator(state.controllerLocator, true)` for the tmux branch; kept, with the external branch via redactExternalController — an explicit field allowlist per api/state.ts's rule.

Constraint (d) note: the operator token is file-only in every production path; `cliOverrides.operatorToken` exists only as the same programmatic seam every DaemonConfig field has (Partial<DaemonConfig>) and is used by tests alone — no CLI flag or environment variable reads it.
